# MSP conformance transcripts

Copied verbatim from https://github.com/meta-models/muse-code-sdk (`schema/msp/transcripts/`,
MIT licence, see LICENSE). They are replayed by `tests/fake_msp_host.py` to validate the
Python MSP client without a real `muse` binary. Regenerate by re-copying from the SDK repo
when the stable fingerprint changes.
